section_header: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Cooling Unit, Refrigerant Lines
title: INSTALLATION OF COOLING UNIT

content.description: Photograph showing cooling unit installation with wire harness connection

items: INSTALL A/C WIRE HARNESS TO COOLING UNIT

INSTALL COOLING UNIT
Install the cooling unit with the three nuts and four bolts.

INSTALL FOLLOWING COMPONENTS:
(a) Side air duct
(b) Glove box with undercover
INSTALL GROMMETS ON INLET AND OUTLET FITTINGS
CONNECT LIQUID LINE TUBE TO COOLING UNIT INLET FITTING
CONNECT SUCTION FLEXIBLE HOSE TO COOLING UNIT OUTLET FITTING

IF EVAPORATOR IS REPLACED, ADD COMPRESSOR OIL TO COMPRESSOR
Add 20 – 35 cc (0.7 – 1.2 fl. oz.)
EVACUATE, CHARGE AND TEST REFRIGERATION SYSTEM (See page AC-12)

content.text: CAUTION: Be careful not to pinch the wire harness while installing the cooling unit.

content.component: LIQUID LINE TUBE TO COOLING UNIT INLET FITTING
SUCTION FLEXIBLE HOSE TO COOLING UNIT OUTLET FITTING

content.description: Photograph showing cooling unit with grommets and line connections

items:
INSPECT HOSES AND TUBES FOR LEAKAGE
Use a gas leak tester. Replace, if necessary.

CHECK THAT HOSE AND TUBE CLAMPS ARE NOT LOOSE
Tighten or replace, as necessary.
